item.title: Léa Seydoux Says Young Actors May Lack The “Gravitas” For James Bond, Recalls Secrecy Around Daniel Craig’s Death
item.description: Few roles in Hollywood carry as much baggage or scrutiny as James Bond. With every new incarnation comes the inevitable debate over who should wear the tuxedo and whether the next actor can measure up to his predecessor. As the franchise prepares for its next chapter under Denis Villeneuve , Léa Seydoux , who starred opposite Daniel Craig in both “ Spectre ” and “ No Time To Die ,” has some thoughts about what the next Bond needs—and why younger actors might struggle to fill his shoes. item.title: ‘Home Alone’: Macaulay Culkin Returning As Kevin McCallister For New Disney Sequel From Seth Rogen & Evan Goldberg
item.description: After more than three decades, Macaulay Culkin is finally ready to return to “ Home Alone ,” and Disney has recruited Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg to help bring Kevin McCallister back to the big screen. The long-discussed sequel/reboot is now officially in development, with the producing duo’s Point Grey banner attached and Culkin involved in developing the story. According to Puck’s Matthew Belloni, Rogen and Goldberg recently closed their deal with Disney and will work alongside Culkin to develop a screenplay. Continue reading ‘Home Alone’: Macaulay Culkin Returning As Kevin McCallister For New Disney Sequel From Seth Rogen & Evan Goldberg at The Playlist.

item.title: 'Polly Pocket': Lili Reinhart Replaces Lily Collin On Amazon MGM & Mattel's Upcoming Film
item.description: Yes, Amazon MGM and Mattel Studios still plan to make their " Polly Pocket " film, first announced five years ago, but there's a creative shakeup afoot. Deadline reports that Lily Collins is out, and has been for a while. Her replacement? Lily Reinhart , who's a proven commodity on streaming, where this one will debut. READ MORE: 'The Love Hypothesis' Teaser Trailer: Lili Reinhart & Tom Bateman Test Their Fake-Dating Chemistry It also bears mentioning that there's someone new in the "Polly Pocket" director's chair, too: Clea DuVall replaces Lena Dunham , who left the project back in June over creative differences.
